input.question: Who is the artist of the album "Welcome to My World"?

documents.text: Welcome to My World (Elvis Presley album) Welcome to My World is a compilation album by American singer and musician Elvis Presley, released by RCA Records in March 1977, five months before his death. The album was certified gold on September 30, 1977 and platinum on January 14, 1983 by the RIAA. Lacking new material to release because of Elvis' infrequent studio recording sessions during this period, RCA Records assembled this album, consisting almost entirely of previously released recordings. According to "Elvis: The Illustrated Record" by Roy Carr and Mick Farren, all but one track on "Welcome to My World"
